faqs.q: How much time does OneCard take to activate?

faqs.q: How much FD is required for One Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- SBM Bank, in collaboration with One Card, offers a secured variant called SBM Bank OneCard Lite Credit Card, which requires a fixed deposit (FD) as collateral. The minimum FD amount required is not officially disclosed by the bank, but once approved, the credit limit can be up to 110% of the FD amount (Max. Rs. 1.10 Lakh).

faqs.q: Which bank offers One Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- One Credit Card is issued in partnership with multiple banks, including SBM Bank, South Indian Bank, BoB Financial (Bank of Baroda), Federal Bank, Indian Bank, and CSB Bank.

faqs.q: What is the One Card Credit Card customer care number?
faqs.a: +- For any queries related to OneCard, you can contact customer service viathe toll-free number at 1800 210 9111, or you can drop an email at help@getonecard.app. Additionally, you can reach out to the respective bank that issued your OneCard regarding any query.

faqs.q: What is the use of One Card Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- OneCard is a metallic credit card that is offered in collaboration with several banks including SBM Bank, South Indian Bank, Federal Bank, BOB Financial and others. This is an entry-level credit card that provides basic benefits to its users such as reward points, EMI conversion and more.

faqs.q: How can I apply for One Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- You can apply for One Card online by visiting the official website of OneCard. Applicants can also download its mobile app and apply through it.

faqs.q: Is there any rewards redemption fee for One Card Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- No, OneCard does not charge any reward redemption fee from its users. You can earn reward points and redeem them without any charges.

faqs.q: Which documents are required to apply for OneCard Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- At the time of application, the applicant has to submit valid identity proof, address proof and income proof (if any). These are the basic documents that an applicant has to submit while applying for any of the OneCard credit cards. However, the partner bank can also ask for any other document, if required.

faqs.q: What is the forex markup fee for OneCard Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- OneCard comes with a lower forex markup fee as compared to the other credit cards available in the market. The forex markup fee charged by OneCard is just 1%, which makes it easier for you to make transactions in foreign currency.

faqs.q: Can I build my credit score using OneCard Credit Card?
faqs.a: +- Yes, OneCard Credit Card is suitable for people who are new to credit. You can apply for this credit card and start building your credit score by using it efficiently. In order to build your credit score, make sure you make your payments timely and in full.

faqs.q: Can students or individuals without a credit history apply for OneCard?
faqs.a: +- Yes, in comparison to other cards, OneCard comes with comparatively relaxed eligibility requirements, making it a suitable choice for people who are new to credit. However, the other eligibility requirements may vary as per the partner bank.

faqs.q: How can I increase the credit limit on OneCard?
